about: GH #326 parity cases. The Rust `window_layout` derivation (agent-doc-editor-surface-io) and the plugin's frozen Kotlin floor (LayoutDetectorTest) both answer every case; a native rule change updates this file and may diverge from the frozen floor only on purpose.

cases.name: two measured windows keep a source split standing for its last document

expected.observed_line: [layout-detect] observed windows=2 snapshots=[(600,0) tasks/recent.md, (0,0) tasks/left.md] columns=2 [tasks/left.md | tasks/recent.md] source=windows

cases.name: history order decides which document a source split stands for

expected.observed_line: [layout-detect] observed windows=2 snapshots=[(0,0) a.md, (640,0) b.md] columns=2 [a.md | b.md] source=windows

cases.name: an unmeasured window makes the whole order unknown

expected.observed_line: [layout-detect] observed windows=2 snapshots=[(0,0) b.md, (0,0) a.md] columns=2 [b.md | a.md] source=windows

cases.name: a window without session documents keeps an empty column

expected.observed_line: [layout-detect] observed windows=2 snapshots=[(0,0) <none>, (600,0) right.md] columns=2 [<empty> | right.md] source=windows

cases.name: stacked windows in one column are not a split

expected.observed_line: [layout-detect] observed windows=2 snapshots=[(0,400) bottom.md, (4,0) top.md] columns=1 [top.md,bottom.md] source=windows

cases.name: no session document in any window is no layout
one local window is a known single column

expected.observed_line: [layout-detect] observed windows=1 snapshots=[(0,0) tasks/local.md] columns=1 [tasks/local.md] source=windows

cases.name: one window showing source is no layout
a cross-root document keeps its absolute path

expected.observed_line: [layout-detect] observed windows=2 snapshots=[(0,0) a.md, (600,0) /other/b.md] columns=2 [a.md | /other/b.md] source=windows
